## Summary

Describe the changes made in this pull request and why they are needed.

## Related Issues

- Closes #

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Telemetry / reverse-engineering improvement (offsets, scene mapping, projections, collectible tracking, emulator/recomp support)
- [ ] Desktop launcher / packaging change (Windows `.exe` / Linux `.AppImage`)
- [ ] Documentation or CI update

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes with all tests green
- [ ] `npm run build` completes cleanly
- [ ] Verified in browser / live emulator or recomp session (if telemetry or UI changed)
- [ ] Verified Windows portable build (`npm run build:win`) or Linux AppImage build (`npm run build:linux`) if launcher or packaging changed
- [ ] UI text, comments, and docs are in English (with localized strings in `i18n`) and contain no copyrighted game assets or personal dumps
